headline: Globalstar Misses Q3 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Globalstar Inc. reported third-quarter earnings that missed analyst expectations by $0.04 per share, with revenue also falling short of estimates.
why: Globalstar is a provider of satellite communications services; earnings misses often lead to volatility in share price as investors reassess growth projections.

impacts.name: Globalstar Inc
impacts.why: The company missed both earnings and revenue estimates.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Earnings misses relative to market expectations typically trigger downward price adjustments as the company's valuation is revised based on lower-than-expected performance.
